info.title: Polpo API
info.description: REST API for Polpo — an AI agent that manages teams of AI coding agents. Manage tasks, missions, agents, playbooks, skills, notifications, and approvals. For conversational interaction, use the OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: API key passed as a Bearer token. Configure via the apiKeys field in polpo.json or the POLPO_API_KEY environment variable.

connectors.description: Connector ids the run may use (each account of an app is its own connector, e.g. gmail-2), or "none". Absent: every connector the agent has.

connectorTools.description: Per connector id: "*" or the server's raw tool names. Narrows the agent's own connectorTools.

allowedTools.description: Built-in tools or patterns (read, bash, browser_*), not connector tools. Narrows the agent's allowedTools (or its default tools).

fastPath.description: Answered without the model (an obvious "go to X")

titleHighlights.description: Matched [start, end) ranges in the title

snippet.description: The matching passage (secrets masked) and its matched [start, end) ranges

url.description: Dashboard route that opens the item

meta.description: Type details: agent, status, messageId, author, columns…

message.description: handoff: the message for a new Polpo chat

auto.description: true: the dashboard does it at once (navigation, view-only commands); false: a button the person clicks

until.description: When the event log took over

before.description: Deliveries counted before the event log existed: totals only, no entry in the log. The other counts are the event log's.

payload.description: The redacted payload (JSON), or a redacted text preview; capped at 4 KB

headers.description: Safe headers only (never a signature or an authorization)

post.description: Polpo's primary conversational interface. Send messages in OpenAI format, receive responses in OpenAI format. Polpo runs its full 37-tool agentic loop internally — you describe what you need, Polpo handles the rest. Supports streaming (SSE) and non-streaming modes.

role.description: Message role. System messages are appended as additional context (Polpo has its own system prompt).

url.description: Base64 data URL for a persistent image attachment

content.description: Message content — plain string or array of content parts (text / image_url)

stream.description: If true, returns an SSE stream of OpenAI-format chunks. If false, returns a complete response.

model.description: Ignored. Polpo uses its configured orchestrator model (or the agent's model in agent-direct mode).

agent.description: Target a specific agent by name for direct conversation. Uses the agent's own model, system prompt, and coding tools instead of the orchestrator. Omit to talk to the orchestrator (default).

focus.description: What the summary should pay particular attention to.

compact.description: Compact the session's context now instead of answering: the earlier conversation is summarized (as when the window fills) and the checkpoint is saved for the next turns. Requires x-session-id of an existing session. Returns { compaction } without calling the model for an answer.

200.description: Chat completion response (non-streaming). When stream=true, returns text/event-stream with OpenAI-format chunks ending with data: [DONE].

400.description: Invalid request (missing messages or no project available)

schema.description: If `true`, returns a slim projection: drops `outcomes`, `result.stdout/stderr` (keeps `result.assessment`; a failed task gets `failure`: its reason in a line, `retryable`, `kind`), `expectations`, `metrics`, `maxRetries`, `runs` (replaced by `lastRun`: engine, model, computer of the latest run, and `cost`: the total of every run `{ usd, tokens, runs, partial? }`), and truncates `description` to 200 chars. Default `false` — full record for backwards compat with the SDK and web UI. Bandwidth-sensitive clients (mobile) should opt in.

parameters.description: If `true`, returns a slim projection: drops `outcomes`, `result.stdout/stderr` (keeps `result.assessment`; a failed task gets `failure`: its reason in a line, `retryable`, `kind`), `expectations`, `metrics`, `maxRetries`, `runs` (replaced by `lastRun`: engine, model, computer of the latest run, and `cost`: the total of every run `{ usd, tokens, runs, partial? }`), and truncates `description` to 200 chars. Default `false` — full record for backwards compat with the SDK and web UI. Bandwidth-sensitive clients (mobile) should opt in.

200.description: Task details. `runs`: where and with what each run executed (engine polpo / claude-code / codex / opencode, model, auth kind, computer, sandbox, egress, harness session, cost, budget, status, duration), newest last. `result.stderr` of a failed task is its labelled reason (a harness error says what to change); `result.retryable: false`: it was not retried automatically (model not enabled for the account, credentials refused). `failure` sums it up: `{ reason, retryable, kind }` (kind: model_access, auth, budget, killed, assessment, error). `cost`: what every run of the task cost in all (first run, retries, continuations, directions): `{ usd, harnessUsd, modelUsd, tokens, runs, lastRunUsd, byEngine, perRun, partial, recoveredUsd? }` — `partial: true` when older runs were dropped (a task keeps its latest 20) and could not be recovered from the usage records.

post.description: Sends the request to the orchestrator's model (settings.orchestratorModel) with the global search as a tool. It answers briefly, picks the results worth opening and returns intents: navigation and view-only commands (auto: true) that the dashboard runs at once, and buttons (auto: false) for anything that changes data, never run here. An obvious "go to X" / "vai a X" naming a page is answered without the model. With stream: true the answer comes as Server-Sent Events whose data is {type: status|delta|results|intent|done|error, …}. Rate limited; bounded rounds, tokens and time.
